candidate_activities.Description: Discover the traditional Al-Musawkaf Market in Unaizah for crafts and heritage.
Tour the traditional Al-Bassam Heritage House in Unaizah, a masterpiece of Najdi architecture.
Relax at the beautiful Al-Hajeb Parks in Unaizah, one of the region's top nature spots.
A major hub for shopping and family entertainment in the heart of Unaizah.
Visit the largest salt lake in the region, Al-Aoshaziyah Lake, for a unique natural experience.
One of the premier shopping and entertainment destinations in Buraydah.
Explore Al-Uqailat Museum in Buraydah, showcasing the history of trade and heritage.
A well-maintained urban garden in Buraydah for leisure and family activities.
The iconic Buraydah Water Tower, offering panoramic views and surrounding park areas.
A spacious green park in Buraydah ideal for family picnics and evening strolls.
Enjoy nature and wildlife at King Khalid Park in Buraydah, perfect for family outings.
A bustling traditional market in Buraydah known for heritage goods and local crafts.
A serene community park in Buraydah for local residents and visitors.
The largest and most modern mall in Tabuk featuring international brands and a cinema.
A high-altitude peak famous for its winter snowfall and historical importance.
Archaeological museum displaying the rich history of the Tabuk region.
Museum documenting the history of the early 20th century rail line.
Historic castle serving as a museum of the region's long history.
A modern outdoor lifestyle destination with premium dining and cafes.
Large green park with sea views and walking tracks.
Peaceful garden perfect for family walks and evening relaxation.
Guided snorkeling and scuba diving tours around the pristine coral reefs of Farasan Islands. Crystal-clear Red Sea waters teeming with tropical fish, sea turtles, rays, and vibrant coral gardens.
Red Sea island trip known for beaches, marine life, coral surroundings, heritage houses, and nature experiences.

Roman-era ruins on Farasan Al-Kabir island, evidence of a Roman garrison outpost dating to the 2nd century AD. Among the southernmost confirmed Roman sites in Arabia, featuring inscribed tablets and structural remains.
Boat tour around Farasan coast, suitable for sea views, island exploration, and marine sightseeing in good weather.
